t: Canonical Wheelwright evolution - object model, behavior, migration, and post-deploy skills
description: Parent epic for the canonical Wheelwright redesign and refactor. Establishes canonical WAI object definitions, spoke/hub behavior, storage structure, and migration-safe closeout semantics.

canonical_focus.goal: Make Wheelwright canonical in its design before implementation expands again.
core_decisions: Wheel / Hub / Spoke / Skills / Advisors / Lugs / Sessions / Tracks are the core model
PEV is represented as linked lugs, not embedded fields
WAI-State.json is the canonical spoke state file
Signals are high-impact lugs routed through WAI-Hub/Signals/incoming/ and processed/
Closeout and migration must be idempotent and concurrency-safe
Ozi is identity/partner framing, not a persistence object

incorporate_now.description: Work that was part of the canonical evolution.

rewrite_first.note: Skills now in WAI-Spoke/skills/{id}/ subfolders — done via skill system evolution
Working agreements now enforced via complexity-advisor and stewardship-advisor skills

post_evolution.description: Remaining work after canonical core is stable.

reconciled_reason: Session 68 audit: updated child statuses to reflect actual completion state. 3 of 5 incorporate_now items completed, 2 rewrite_first items superseded by evolved skill system. 1 post_evolution item superseded. Remaining open items are valid backlog.
